name: Miyako Hanna
source:
Homeless, unemployed, naturally positive, and a wild girl!! Despite being at rock bottom, she's incredibly positive and absurdly cheerful.

As long as she can have her beloved sex, isn't starving, and isn't cold, she's totally fine—a true tropical island spirit.

She's a “naked tie fetishist,” so she always wears a tie and collar except in the bath. She has absolutely no worries about the future!

[From [url=https://www.getchu.com/soft.phtml?id=785433]getchu[/url]]
